title: Closeout summary: File and surface declared gates via CLI and directives
body:
Subject: work:bw_work_aac15271c8621eed
Status: verified
Priority: high

## Outcome

WHY: a declared gate only prevents drift if the executor sees it at pickup. WHAT: (1) filing - extend the --required-gate parsing (apps/cli/src/commands.ts lines 10978-10989, currently kind or kind:scope) or add companion flags such as --gate-command and --gate-expect on work create and work edit, with usage documented in the command registry (apps/cli/src/command-registry.ts around line 1124); (2) surfacing - emit an advisory gap for every open declared gate on work show, work claim and agent start so the sprint 3 registry renders a blocking directive stating the exact command and expected observable at claim time (this depends on the sprint 3 inversion for the rendering path); (3) update the agent guide finish and evidence command hints (commands.ts lines 11114-11133) to echo the declared command when one exists instead of the generic pnpm test placeholder. Include the declared gate fields in WorkItemView requiredCloseoutGates output, which already passes gates through (packages/ui-model/src/work-view.ts line 134).

## Evidence

- bw_evidence_b9f4cef1ae48c072: passed Declared gate filing and surfacing passed: work create/edit round-trip --gate-command and --gate-expect, work show emits declared gate gap metadata, work show/work claim/agent start emit verification directives with declared command and observable, and agent guide echoes the active declared command. Validation passed: pnpm check; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/cli.test.ts tests/runtime/cli-agent-directives.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-compiler.test.ts --testTimeout 15000; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/agent-directive-goldens.test.ts --testTimeout 10000; pnpm test. Git checkpoint 83bc26a4.
